SELECT e.id, e.request_user_id AS requestUserId, u.name AS requestUserName, u.phone AS requestUserPhone, e.type, e.response_admin_id AS responseAdminId, a.name AS responseAdminName, e.call_range AS callRange, e.call_time AS callTime, e.call_position AS callPosition, e.call_longitude AS callLongitude, e.call_latitude AS callLatitude, e.target_position AS targetPosition, e.status, e.create_time AS createTime, e.update_time AS updateTime
,( 6371 * ACOS( LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, COS(RADIANS(#{query.latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(e.call_latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(e.call_longitude) - RADIANS(#{query.longitude})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{query.latitude})) * SIN(RADIANS(e.call_latitude)) )) ) ) AS distance
FROM emergency_call e LEFT JOIN user_info u ON e.request_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON e.response_admin_id = a.id WHERE e.status = 0
AND e.type = #{query.type}
HAVING distance <= #{query.maxDistance}
ORDER BY
distance ASC,
e.call_time DESC

SELECT e.id, e.request_user_id AS requestUserId, u.name AS requestUserName, u.phone AS requestUserPhone, u.avatar AS requestUserAvatar, e.type, e.call_range AS callRange, e.call_time AS callTime, e.call_position AS callPosition, e.call_longitude AS callLongitude, e.call_latitude AS callLatitude, e.target_position AS targetPosition, e.target_longitude AS targetLongitude, e.target_latitude AS targetLatitude, e.response_admin_id AS responseAdminId, a.name AS responseAdminName, e.status, e.create_time AS createTime, e.update_time AS updateTime FROM emergency_call e LEFT JOIN user_info u ON e.request_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON e.response_admin_id = a.id WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCallCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(call_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCallCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS respondingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, AVG( CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2) AND response_admin_id IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, call_time, update_time) ELSE NULL END ) AS avgResponseTime FROM emergency_call
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(call_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS myTodayResponseCount, COUNT(*) AS myTotalResponseCount FROM emergency_call WHERE response_admin_id = #{adminId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM emergency_call WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT status FROM emergency_call WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT response_admin_id FROM emergency_call WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM emergency_call WHERE response_admin_id = #{adminId} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE emergency_call SET response_admin_id = #{adminId}, status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE emergency_call SET target_position = #{targetPosition}, target_longitude = #{targetLongitude}, target_latitude = #{targetLatitude}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE emergency_call SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE emergency_call SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1)
